text_block_list.text:
While I'm out shopping, I see Biko
Pegasus
patrolling the district... with
Шинко Винди
secretly trailing behind
her.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
Gah! Ya really wanna know what my plan
is? All
right, you've backed me into a
corner, so I'll tell
ya!
text_block_list.name: Шинко Винди

text_block_list.text:
I'm gonna steal all the glory of Biko's
patrol! I call
it... Operation: Justice
Extermination!
text_block_list.name: Шинко Винди

text_block_list.text:
She's so full of herself! I asked her to
play tag, but
she turned me down to do
this stupid patrol!
text_block_list.name: Шинко Винди

text_block_list.text:
I even tried waiting till she was done to
ask again,
but she just went back to her
dorm...
text_block_list.name: Шинко Винди

text_block_list.text:
So this is my plan! If anything bad
happens, I'll
swoop in and save the day
first so she won't be
able to—
text_block_list.name: Шинко Винди

text_block_list.text:
See you later, granny! Take care to
watch your
step now!
text_block_list.name: Бико Пегасус

text_block_list.text:
Hey, Biko! Did you just help someone?! I
was
supposed to do that and get all the
glory!
text_block_list.name: Шинко Винди

text_block_list.text:
Glory? Oh, are you offering to help?
Thanks!
There's always so much
happening around here
that I'll take all
the help I can get!
text_block_list.name: Бико Пегасус

text_block_list.text:
You got it all wrong! I'm not offering to
help!
Ugh, why would you even ask me
to do something
so draining?
text_block_list.name: Шинко Винди
choice_data_list: Come on, help lessen her burden.

text_block_list.text:
Huh?! I-I have no idea what you're
talking about!
text_block_list.name: Шинко Винди

text_block_list.text:
The truth? Is there something you want
to say to
me? It's okay! Lay it on me!
text_block_list.name: Бико Пегасус

text_block_list.text:
Nngh... Nnnngh... No! Just shut up! I hate
all of
you!
text_block_list.name: Шинко Винди

text_block_list.text:
I point out that Бико Пегасус might be
declining
her offers to play tag because
she's too tired from
her patrols.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
If I help her, does that mean she'll still
have
enough energy to play tag with me
after she's
done?!
text_block_list.name: Шинко Винди

text_block_list.text:
F-fine! I'll help out! You'd better be
grateful,
Biko!
text_block_list.name: Шинко Винди

text_block_list.text:
So the pair patrol together... and peace
once
again prevails in the shopping
district.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
Шинко Винди turns beet-red and blurts
out her
words hastily before sprinting
away as fast as she
can.
text_block_list.name: Монолог
